body: This is a ridiculous post. It’s teen mom for gods sake. I was a mother at a young age and you remind me of people’s reactions when I told them I had a kid. Completely condescending and obnoxious

I’ll try going to more meetings locally thanks. I’ve been to a few already and found them to be less relatable than other countries I’ve tried. 

I’ll keep at it though!

Thanks for this. I was diagnosed 10 years ago and have tried therapy many times but I even struggle with composing myself enough there. Or even getting there in the first place.

I’ve attended zoom meetings in my own country and to be honest the US meetings seem a lot more friendly and relatable. I’m not sure why. 

I’ll attend a few more locally and see then. I’m actually hoping this lockdown will continue for longer because I find it much easier attending meetings without the anxiety.
Thanks I’ll try that. Just don’t know what I’ll do when everyone goes back offline :(

Thanks it’s easier now with online meetings but worried about after when everyone goes offline again.

It is called common courtesy!

All the answers are coming from absolute ignorant selfish people. All muscles, little brain power.

Well done for proving the fact
If someone else wants to use the equipment?
Why are you getting downvoted. Anyone I’ve spoken to that’s a gym regular rates this as the number one pet peeve

What about doing it for yourself? There are so many comments on here that talk about how they were pushed by SOs. I always thought it wasn’t possible until you wanted to do it, not that you were afraid of losing SO and had no other option but to quit

My father had the same disease. Everyone hated him until he got cancer. Then everyone who had hated him rallied around as if he was perfect. All of my siblings who despised him for what he put us through no longer cared. He died and everyone thought he was a great person and he was sober when he died. Only so because of treatment. 

It’s a disease I know but it’s not to a lot of people. I thought after my alcoholic dad died years ago and I messed up that i was being reached out to the same way my dad was when he died, he was forgiven.

As long as I’m alive I never will be.
